subject: basketball
doc: Rule facts used by the staged basketball content and claimed in live lessons, each checked by code against the rulebook text (offline-sources/basketball, see its SOURCES.md and SHA256SUMS). A fact passes only if every regex matches the named source (whitespace normalised). Facts no downloaded source covers are listed as 'unverified_here' and go to the two free judges, then to a human check; they are NOT marked verified.

facts.claim: The three-point arc has a radius of 6.75 m.
patterns: arc of radius 6\.75 m

facts.claim: The free-throw line's furthest edge is 5.80 m from the inner edge of the endline.
patterns: furthest\s+edge 5\.80 m from the inner edge of the endline

facts.claim: A game is 4 quarters of 10 minutes.
patterns: 4 quarters of 10 minutes each

facts.claim: Overtimes are 5 minutes, as many as needed to break the tie.
patterns: overtimes of 5 minutes each as necessary to break the tie

facts.claim: A team must attempt a shot within 24 seconds.
patterns: attempt a shot for a goal within 24 seconds

facts.claim: The shot clock resets to 14 seconds in set frontcourt situations (e.g. a frontcourt throw-in after a foul or violation, or the same team regaining control after the ball touches the ring).
patterns: Frontcourt, the shot clock shall be reset to 14 seconds
14 seconds, if the team which regains control of the ball is the same team

facts.claim: The ball must be brought into the frontcourt within 8 seconds.
patterns: into its frontcourt within 8 seconds

facts.claim: Three-second rule exists (Article 26).
patterns: Article 26 3 seconds

facts.claim: A closely guarded player must pass, shoot or dribble within 5 seconds.
patterns: closely guarded player must pass, shoot or dribble the ball within 5 seconds

facts.claim: A throw-in must be released within 5 seconds.
patterns: Take more than 5 seconds to release the ball

facts.claim: A player with 5 fouls must leave the game.
patterns: A player who has committed 5 fouls shall be informed of it by a referee and must leave

facts.claim: A team is in the team foul penalty after 4 team fouls in a quarter (so the 5th brings free throws); overtime fouls count with the 4th quarter.
patterns: team foul penalty situation after it has\s+committed 4 team fouls in a quarter
committed in each overtime shall be considered as being committed in

facts.claim: After ending a dribble a player may not touch the court consecutively with the same foot or both feet.
patterns: may not touch the court consecutively with the same foot or both\s+feet after ending the dribble

facts.claim: An injured player who cannot continue immediately (within approximately 15 seconds) must be substituted.
patterns: cannot continue to play immediately \(within approximately 15

facts.claim: The no-charge semi-circle is 1.30 m from the point under the centre of the basket to its OUTER edge (2026 text); the older wording '1.25 m' measured to the inner edge of a 5 cm line describes the same line.
patterns: radius of 1\.30 m measured from the point on the court\s+beneath the exact centre of the basket to the outer edge
facts.note: Lesson B06:66 says '1.25 metre FIBA ... semicircle'. Flag for the owner: say '1.25 m to the inner edge (1.30 m to the outer edge, FIBA 2026)'.

facts.claim: NBA arc 23 ft 9 in from the middle of the basket, with lines 3 ft from the sidelines in the corners.
patterns: parallel lines 3. from the sidelines
arc of 23.9. from the middle of the basket

facts.claim: The NBA restricted area is a half-circle 4 ft from the centre of the basket ring.
patterns: Restricted Area shall be marked with a half-circle 4. from the center of the basket ring

facts.claim: NBA periods are twelve minutes; overtimes five minutes.
patterns: regulation play in the NBA will be twelve minutes
overtime periods of play will be five minutes

facts.claim: The NBA shot clock resets to 14 seconds in set situations.
patterns: reset to 14 seconds

facts.claim: An NBA player is disqualified on the sixth personal foul.
patterns: disqualified from the game when he receives his sixth personal foul

facts.claim: In NBA overtime, common team fouls in excess of three are penalised with free throws.
patterns: During any overtime period, common fouls charged as team fouls in excess of three

facts.claim: Below the free-throw line extended an offensive player may not dribble with back or side to the basket for more than five seconds.
patterns: below the free throw line extended shall not be permitted to dribble with his back or side to the basket for more than five seconds

facts.claim: The NBA has a defensive three-second rule.
patterns: Defensive Three-Second Rule

facts.claim: Maximum organised basketball per week: 3 h (7-8), 5 h (9-11), 10 h (12-14), 14 h (grades 9-12).
patterns: Ages 7-8 1 3 hours Ages 9-11 2\* 5 hours Ages 12-14 2\* 10 hours\*\* Grades 9-12 2\* 14 hours

facts.claim: Minimum rest days per week: 2 (7-8), 2 (9-11), 1 (12-14), 1 (grades 9-12).
patterns: Ages 7-8 2 4 months 9-12 hours Ages 9-11 2 5 months 9-12 hours Ages 12-14 1 7 months 8-10 hours\* Grades 9-12 1 9-10 months

facts.claim: Delay specialisation in basketball until at least age 14.
patterns: Delay specialization in basketball until at least age 14

facts.claim: Ages 7-8: 1 practice a week of 30-60 minutes recommended.
patterns: Ages 7-8 20-28 min 1 30-60 min 1

unverified_here.claim: NCAA allows ten seconds to cross half court (lesson B04:37).
NFHS: eight-minute quarters, a 19 ft 9 in arc, shot clocks only in adopting states (lesson B05:63).
unverified_here.why: NFHS rules are not free to download

unverified_here.claim: NFHS two shots from the fifth team foul each quarter; NCAA men's one-and-one; NBA last-two-minute penalty (lesson B05:58).
unverified_here.why: NFHS/NCAA not downloaded; the NBA part matches nba12's 'last two minutes' quota text

unverified_here.claim: NBA transition take foul: one free throw plus possession outside the last two minutes (lesson B07:53).
unverified_here.why: not found in the downloaded rule pages (may sit in Rule 12 comments)
the ring height is in FIBA's separate Basketball Equipment document, not in the rules text
